name: Plan Gap Year
description: Guides the user through planning a gap year or extended career break, chaining career strategy, budgeting, savings, learning design, itinerary building, and safety preparation skills across four categories. Use when the user wants to take a gap year, plan an extended travel break, or structure a career sabbatical with intentional learning and travel goals. Do NOT use for short vacations (under 1 month), retirement planning, or employer-sponsored sabbaticals with fixed structure.
